articles.title: New Mexico AG lawsuit accuses Epstein's attorney and accountant of facilitating sex trafficking

articles.title: Intel hits construction milestone at Ohio chip fab that’s at least 5 years behind schedule

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Why real-world assets need fixed-rate loans onchain
articles.description: Real-world assets already back the largest stablecoins, yet borrowing against them onchain still runs through variable-rate pools. Peter Gaffney of O2O Capital Partners explains why fixed-rate, fixed-term lending is the missing piece, and how a 5% shift in Sky and Ethena reserves could create $1.8 billion of demand for real-world assets.
